rationale: The guide's first-step section tells a new researcher to select a proposal and identify its source claim, falsifiable mechanism or hypothesis, required public capabilities, and evidence gaps, but offers no copy-ready shape for that first offline note. A short scaffold there would make the existing route actionable while keeping proposals separate from measured results. The pre-edit opportunities check passed; the links check reported five missing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md targets in CONTRIBUTING.md and first-contribution.md.
offline_access: Offline documentation planning and local validation are available without an invite, wallet, installed OpenForage package, daemon, or worker. The startup helper reported that the package is not installed; that does not block this contribution route.
completion_criteria: Add a concise, copy-ready offline note scaffold covering the selected proposal and primary-source claim, falsifiable mechanism and hypothesis, required public capabilities, evidence gaps, and one next offline step.
Keep proposals and hypotheses clearly distinct from results; preserve unknown or unavailable capabilities and metrics, and do not imply that live access is needed to write the note.
Run the opportunities and links validators plus git diff --check after editing; introduce no new failures, and keep the five baseline missing-link targets out of scope unless separately authorized.
Keep the diff focused on the selected documentation and preserve unrelated workspace changes.
